map.输入两个参数，自动计算常用结果: Enter two parameters to auto-calculate common results
map.拉链长度 = 开口 + 2×余量；纽扣数量 = ceil(开口/间距)+1: Zipper length = opening + 2× margin; button count = ceil(opening/spacing)+1
map.💡 辅料（拉链/纽扣）按服装部位开口尺寸与间距推算规格与数量。: 💡 Trim (zipper/button) specs and quantities are derived from the opening size and spacing of garment parts.
map.按门襟/开口长度算纽扣数量与间距: Calculate button count and spacing from placket/opening length
map.选拉链长度匹配开口并留余量: Select zipper length matching the opening with margin
map.核对辅料规格与工艺单一致性: Verify trim specs against the production order
map.门襟长 60 cm、纽扣间距 10 cm → 纽扣数 = 60 / 10 + 1: Placket 60 cm, button spacing 10 cm → buttons = 60 / 10 + 1 = 7 pcs (including both ends); spacing 12 cm gives 6 pcs.
map.开口 55 cm、拉链应 ≥ 开口 + 2 cm 余量 → 选 58–60 cm: Opening 55 cm, zipper should be ≥ opening + 2 cm margin → choose 58–60 cm closed-end zipper; add 3 cm more if a bottom facing is needed.
map.按门襟受力与美观，常 8–12 cm；厚呢料可加密防豁口。: Typically 8–12 cm by placket stress and appearance; thick wool may use denser spacing to prevent gaping.
map.拉链为什么要留余量？: Why leave margin on a zipper?
map.上止/下止需咬合空间，拉链过短拉不到头或暴口，一般比开口长 2–5 cm。: The top/bottom stops need engagement space; a too-short zipper cannot fully close or may burst, so it is generally 2–5 cm longer than the opening.
map.辅料（拉链/纽扣）规格。纺织服装工具，帮助计算面料参数与用量。: Trim (zipper/button) specification. A textile tool that helps calculate fabric parameters and usage.
